description:
Who we are:


Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world.


We are looking for:


We are looking for a DevOps engineer.


As a DevOps Engineer, you play a crucial role in bridging the gap between development and operations teams to streamline the software development lifecycle. You are an important contributor to improve speed and quality of software delivery. You will interact with many stakeholders: product owners, developers, testers, architects and business analysts at solution level, product design authorities, product line managers and customer representatives.


What you will do:


  • Deploy, configure, maintain and upgrade applications and services across multiple Kubernetes clusters and namespaces.
  • Integrate software components and services delivered by multiple engineering teams into stable and operational environments.
  • Develop, maintain and optimize CI/CD pipelines to enable reliable and repeatable deployments.
  • Perform end-to-end deployment, configuration and validation of releases across development, integration, test and production-like environments.
  • Monitor platform health, availability and performance using observability and logging solutions.
  • Perform rapid root-cause analysis and troubleshooting of application, infrastructure, deployment and networking issues.
  • Work closely with developers, testers, architects, product owners and project managers to resolve technical challenges and delivery blockers.
  • Contribute to planning activities by providing effort estimations, technical assessments and deployment strategies.
  • Automate operational tasks, deployment activities and environment management processes.
  • Implement and maintain security best practices across platforms, infrastructure and deployment processes.
  • Support release management activities and ensure platform readiness for testing, demonstrations, customer deliveries and operational activities.
  • Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies, including AI-enabled engineering and infrastructure capabilities.
  • Drive continuous improvement of deployment, integration and operational processes.


What you need to have:


  • Strong experience administering and troubleshooting Linux-based environments.
  • Strong knowledge of Kubernetes architecture, administration and operations.
  • Experience managing multi-cluster and multi-namespace environments.
  • Strong knowledge of Helm and Kubernetes deployment patterns.
  • Experience with Docker and containerized applications.
  • CI/CD & Automation
  • Expertise with GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins or equivalent automation platforms.
  • Strong scripting skills using Python and/or Bash.
  • Strong knowledge of Git-based development workflows.
  • Experience with Ansible for deployment and configuration management.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools, including Terraform.
  • Integration & Troubleshooting
  • Proven experience integrating distributed systems and software services.
  • Strong troubleshooting and debugging capabilities across application, platform and infrastructure layers.
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics and traces to identify and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Experience supporting microservice-based architectures.
  • Strong understanding of deployment dependencies, release processes and environment management.
  • Monitoring & Observability
  • Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch or similar monitoring and logging platforms.
  • Experience designing dashboards, alerts and operational monitoring solutions.
  • Networking & Security
  • Good understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, certificates, ingress controllers and load-balancing concepts.
  • Experience diagnosing connectivity and service communication issues.
  • Knowledge of container and Kubernetes security best practices.
  • Experience managing vulnerabilities, security hardening and secure deployment practices.



What's in it for you:


  • Extended compensation and benefits package.
  • Continuous learning opportunities to enhance your professional and soft skills.
  • A great working environment with people who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do and understand the importance of team spirit.


We really welcome open-minded and committed people:


  • Eager to take on new challenges and learn new things.
  • Who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do.
  • Who enjoy sharing knowledge and understand the importance of teams.


Only eligible candidates will be contacted to move forward in the recruitment process.
